blockingFindings.description: Direct V23 sit view still exposes both fitted shorts and substantial upper thighs: the extended front apron falls behind the seated thighs instead of remaining across them. The crouch view covers more but shows the lap panels lifting off the bent legs. The bounded 80 mm extension and 25 mm projection did not resolve coverage.
V23 front, side and rear views still show irregular planar corrugation, pinched folds and a lumpy side/rear mass rather than controlled skirt pleats.
Direct back view still does not make the waist adjustment tab or buckle identifiable.
The V23 mesh showcase continues to record authored UV status MISSING; a topology illustration is not a UV layout.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
